messages:
Alex: Hey team — my promo code GIFT-APRIL-50 is being rejected as invalid/expired during checkout via the JS SDK. It shows active in the dashboard but checkout throws a 400. Need the credit applied to start the trial. 
Emma: Sorry about that, forwarding to eng. Can you paste the exact code, email, org, and browser request id?
Alex: Code: GIFT-APRIL-50
Email: alex+prod@example.com
Org: acme-prod
Checkout SDK: checkout.js v1.4.2
Tried at 2026-03-12T22:05:10Z
Emma: Reproducing locally now, tagging @Jake. Seeing 400 invalid_code in proxy logs.
Jake: Looking into it. What error body do you get?
Alex: Browser response: `{
  "error": "coupon_invalid",
  "message": "code not found or expired"
}`
Jake: Got it. Quick sanity check on promotions store shows row exists: active=true, expires_at=2026-04-01T00:00:00Z. So dashboard and store disagree with edge behavior. Suspect cache/invalidation problem after last week's promo-store migration.
Emma: Can you share the request/response headers (X-Request-ID)?
Alex: X-Request-ID: xreq-9f3b2c. I also have network HAR if needed.
Jake: Found the request in our logs. The redeem call was routed to a legacy promotion shard (fallback) that doesn't have the migrated code index, so redeem returns not found. The dashboard reads the canonical store, which explains discrepancy.
Emma: @PromoBot can you flush promo cache for acme-prod in us-east-1?
PromoBot: promo-cache-flush accepted for acme-prod/us-east-1; job 8765 queued :white_check_mark:
Jake: Flushed edge cache; invalidation propagated to CDN. Alex — please retry.
Alex: Retried just now, still rejects with same coupon_invalid response.
Jake: Hm. Looking deeper — the redeem request was still routed to legacy shard because routing policy picks fallback when read-traffic to canonical store is high. We'll temporarily force routing to canonical store for promo reads for acme-prod while we patch.
Jake: Patch deployed to routing layer to prefer canonical promotions-store for reads for that org. Monitoring.
Emma: As short-term relief, we can issue a manual $50 credit to the account. Alex, want us to proceed?
Alex: Yes please, manual credit would be great.
PromoBot: manual-credit-created id mc-4453 amount 50 USD for alex+prod@example.com by Emma — pending confirmation.
Jake: I also kicked off a background job to sync legacy shard entries with canonical store and added a safety check to the redeem handler to surface a clearer error when shard data is stale.
Lisa: I'll open a postmortem and add a follow-up: (1) run a full shard consistency check, (2) add alerting when dashboard/store disagree on promo state, (3) add SDK warning when backend responds with stale-store syndrome.
Alex: Confirmed manual credit received on the account, thanks everyone :tada:
Emma: Closing loop here. We'll send a support email with details and timeline. @Lisa please add this to the weekly eng-ops agenda for the migration follow-up.
Lisa: Added to backlog and scheduled a postmortem session for Friday 10:00am PT.
Jake: Monitoring shows error count dropped to baseline after routing patch. Will keep an eye through EOD.
Emma: Thanks all — marking resolved for this customer and will publish a short KB article for internal agents on how to handle similar requests.
